RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current 60-second sliding window.

RateLimitReset.description:
Seconds until the oldest counted request ages out of the sliding window
and the next request slot frees up (delta seconds, not a Unix timestamp).

DateRangeTo.name: to

DeliveredQuery.description:
Filter by derived delivery success. Pass the strings `true` or `false`
(not a JSON boolean).
DeliveredQuery.name: delivered

DestinationIdQuery.description: Restrict to one destination id. Unknown or inaccessible ids return an empty page, not 404.

Restrict to one connection id. An id outside the key's access returns
an empty page (or zero counts on metrics), not 404.
SyncConnectionIdQuery.name: connectionId

BadRequest.description:
Missing or invalid query (from/to required ISO-8601, span at most 31
days, from <= to, or malformed cursor).

Conflict.description:
Sync retry is not eligible, or a source bulk retry cannot start.
Messages include: `Sync is not eligible for retry`,
`Sync is missing webhook or connection context`,
`Retry is only supported for HubSpot and Salesforce syncs`,
`Sync payload is no longer available to retry`,
`User is not approved for this webhook`,
`Sync is paused for this connection`, or
`Sync is paused for this webhook receiver`.
A pause or missing entitlement does not start the 24-hour window.
A bulk retry already requested inside its 24-hour window is
`SyncBulkRetryConflict` on `POST /api/v1/sources/{sourceId}/syncs/retry`,
not this schema. That body includes `retryAvailableAt` and
`retryAfterSeconds`, and its message points at
`POST /api/v1/syncs/{id}/retry`, which has no daily limit.

Forbidden.description: Valid key but no API-enabled connections (`canUseApi`)

GatewayTimeout.description:
The request's database work exceeded the query time limit (20s) and was cancelled.
Returned as JSON instead of the hosting router's HTML timeout page. For windowed
endpoints, narrow `from`/`to` or pass `connectionId`; otherwise retry shortly.

NotFound.description: Resource missing or not in the API key's accessible connections

TooManyRequests.description:
Rate limit exceeded — per-account 120 req/60s (sliding window), the
per-IP pre-auth floor 120 req/60s (fixed window), or, on
`contacts/outreach`, its own 600 req/60s per-account bucket (fixed
window). Always sets Retry-After. Only the per-account limit sets the
X-RateLimit-* headers; the per-IP and outreach 429s send Retry-After
alone.

schema.description: Seconds until the client may retry

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked API key

ApiError.description: Body of every /api/v1 error response, including 404 for an unknown or unshipped path (`message: "Cannot GET /api/v1/…"`).

Reserved CRM blocklist namespace. In this release `evaluated` is always false,
`matched` is always false, and `matches` is always empty. Do not treat that as
"not on a blocklist" — reverse lookup is not run until a later release.

(e.g. keep rows where daysSinceLastTouch is null or >= 90).

Per-component status. Components present depend on the deployment
(production/staging include the destination workers; local omits
them). Treat unknown keys as forward-compatible.

schema_version.description: Version of this response contract. Currently 3.

Set when connectionScope is connection; null for account-scoped keys.
Same as connections[].id when scoped.

data.description: Structured event payload; shape depends on event type.
Structured event payload; shape depends on event type.

delivered.description: True when at least one delivery has SUCCEEDED.

path.description: Source ingress code (slug in the paste URL), not the full URL.

step0.description: True when the account has zero CRM profiles/connections.

steps.description: Account-level steps (account.billing, crm.connect, crm.oauth). Ids are unique, so a client may look a step up by id; per-connection state lives in connections[].

wizardDisabled.description: Account-level preference — user turned off wizard nudges (redirect + nag).

syncEnabled.description: Per-source CRM sync switch. When false, inbound events are held and not synced to the CRM, and retry returns 409.

url.description: Paste URL for the sequencer (includes webhook ingress code).

excludeFreeEmailDomains.description: Skip free/personal email domains (gmail.com, yahoo.com, …) when matching or creating CRM companies. The company website from the sales engagement platform, then the company name, are used instead.

salesforceNoCompanyAccount.description: Salesforce Contact syncs only: Account for contacts with no usable company. DEDICATED creates one Account per contact, NONE creates the Contact without an Account, SHARED pools them under one "Unknown Company" Account. Returned for every source.

lastReceivedAt.description: When live traffic first proved this source, refreshed at most hourly thereafter — treat it as "has live traffic arrived", not as a liveness heartbeat.

queued.description:
True when the batch was accepted. This is not a count of eligible
rows; a source with nothing to retry still returns true.

retryAfterSeconds.description:
Seconds from this response until `retryAvailableAt`. Null when
`queued` is false.

retryAvailableAt.description:
When another bulk retry of this source will be accepted, measured
from the request that started the current 24-hour window. Null when
`queued` is false.

sourceId.description: Source whose failed syncs were queued.

SyncMetrics.description: Exact counts over the whole from/to window, classified exactly like each sync's `status` in `GET /api/v1/syncs`, so `success + warning + error` equals the number of syncs listed for the same filters.

error.description: Includes syncs that never recorded a result (interrupted before completing, or in flight for the few seconds a sync takes) — the same rows `GET /api/v1/syncs?status=error` returns.
CRM result payload when present; otherwise null.

notes.description: Informational notes about decisions made during the sync (status is unaffected), e.g. FREE_EMAIL_DOMAIN_COMPANY_SKIPPED, FREE_EMAIL_DOMAIN_MATCHED_BY_NAME, FREE_EMAIL_DOMAIN_MATCHED_BY_WEBSITE. Empty when none.

enabledEvents.description: Empty array means all active event types.

eventId.description: Public event id (`osevt_...`) queued for delivery.

Public REST API for OutboundSync account introspection, pipeline status,

get.description:
Aggregated prior engagement for contact identities across accessible CRM
connections. Pass `email` and/or one or more `profileUrl` values (LinkedIn
`/in/…` or `/pub/…`, or X/Twitter). At least one identity is required. At
most 5 `profileUrl` values. All supplied identities are OR-unioned into
one aggregate (intended for one contact row — do not mix unrelated people).

Social-only sequencer events: HubSpot/Salesforce backfill `to_email` with
the profile URL when email is missing — use `profileUrl` for those
lookups. Prefer `email` when available (broader CRM + category coverage).

Profile URL matching expands scheme/www/case/slash variants (scheme
optional) and canonicalizes LinkedIn overlay/mwlite/country hosts to
`/in|pub/{slug}` and X status URLs to `/{handle}`.

Counts are deduped by inbound payload id **per event type × platform**
(CRM retry duplicate logs). Designed for spreadsheet enrichment tools
(ZoomInfo GTM Studio, Clay, Databar, Freckle, and similar).

`everContacted` excludes open/click-only tracking and passive social
views/likes. `found` is true when webhook log rows and/or a lead category
signal exist. `doNotContact` covers hard signals only (bounce / unsubscribe).
`blocklists` is a reserved CRM blocklist namespace — `evaluated` is always
false in this release (do not treat `matched: false` as "not on a list").
Company/domain rollup is a separate reserved path
(`GET /api/v1/accounts/outreach?domain=`, not implemented) — do not pass a
bare domain as `email` or `profileUrl` here.
Timestamps are processing time (`webhook_logs.created_at`).

Rate limit: 600 requests / 60 seconds per account (separate from the
general v1 120/min limit).

parameters.description: Contact email (case-insensitive normalize on input). Optional when profileUrl is provided.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description:
LinkedIn (`/in/…` or `/pub/…`) or X/Twitter profile URL. Scheme is
optional (e.g. `linkedin.com/in/jane`). Repeat the parameter or
comma-separate to pass multiple (max 5). Optional when email is provided.
Profile-URL matching resolves only for contacts synced through HubSpot or
Salesforce; Attio/Close/HighLevel/Pipedrive social-only events are not
matched by `profileUrl` — pass `email` for those.
parameters.name: profileUrl

post.description:
No request body. Requires the API key's `write` scope. The write check
runs before the source is loaded, so a read-only key receives 403 even
for an unknown id.

Enqueue only. Re-queues recorded errors from the last 30 days for that
source. Warnings are skipped. Syncs with no result row (in flight, or
interrupted before a result was saved) are not included; retry those
with `POST /api/v1/syncs/{id}/retry`. HubSpot and Salesforce only.
`queued: true` means the batch was accepted, including when no rows
are eligible. It does not mean every row is already on the CRM queue.

Before calling this, retry one sync that already has a recorded error
with `POST /api/v1/syncs/{id}/retry` and read that same id until it
succeeds. That checks the remediation is in place. This route spends
the source's 24-hour window even when the underlying issue is still
broken, and a later failure in the batch does not return the window.
List ids with `GET /api/v1/syncs?status=error` or
`GET /api/v1/sources/{sourceId}/syncs?status=error`.

One bulk retry per source per 24 hours, measured from this request.
`retryAvailableAt` is when the next bulk retry will be accepted.
`retryAfterSeconds` is how long remains from this response. A 409 for
a source already inside that window returns the same two fields.

`POST /api/v1/syncs/{id}/retry` has no daily limit and stays available
during the bulk window.

403.description:
Valid key but no API-enabled connections (`canUseApi`), or the key
is missing the `write` scope (`API key requires the "write" scope`).

409.description:
Two bodies share this status.

`SyncBulkRetryConflict`: a bulk retry for this source was already
requested inside the current 24-hour window. `retryAvailableAt` and
`retryAfterSeconds` describe that window. Retry one sync with
`POST /api/v1/syncs/{id}/retry`, which has no daily limit.

`ApiError`: the bulk retry cannot start and the 24-hour window was
not taken. Messages are `Retry is only supported for HubSpot and
Salesforce syncs`, `User is not approved for this webhook`,
`Sync is paused for this connection`, or
`Sync is paused for this webhook receiver`.

post.summary: Enqueue a retry of failed CRM syncs for one source

post.description:
No request body. Requires the API key's `write` scope. Connection-scoped
keys can retry. The write check runs before the sync is loaded, so a
read-only key receives 403 even for an unknown id.

Enqueue only — the response does not wait for the CRM write. The retry
updates that same sync id. Read it again after the worker finishes.
Retry is supported for HubSpot and Salesforce syncs whose status is
error. Success and warning are not eligible. This route has no daily
limit.

Use this to confirm a fix on one recorded error before
`POST /api/v1/sources/{sourceId}/syncs/retry`. A bulk retry spends that
source's 24-hour window even when the underlying issue is still broken.
